global_boundary.formal_kernel: Two matching local Lean runs accepted 55 of 55 named H6 theorems and the complete axiom audit. The final local receipt binds that run to the exact package bytes and declared trust base; independent external reproduction remains open.
global_boundary.representation: The Lean proof is relative to its inductive formal grammar and codec. EBNF, reference object, manifest and digests connect human-readable bytes to the package but do not make an unverified production text parser kernel-proved.
global_boundary.empirical: H6 contains no new physical measurement and does not convert inherited measurements into quantum-gravity evidence.
global_boundary.interpretive: Sphere, outward growth and virtual cosmogenesis are explanatory readings of the certified transition structure, not measured spatial geometry.
global_boundary.normative: Preserving provenance, responsibility and an effect haltpoint is a governance commitment kept separate from formal and empirical truth.
global_boundary.open: PhysicalClosure, physical Big Bang identity, empirical promotion and independent public reproduction remain outside the local VirtualClosure theorem.
